title: The Ascetic and the Thieves
logline: Three thieves take a holy man's goat without touching it: one after another they call it a dog until he doubts his own eyes and leaves it by the road.
moral: A lie does not become true because three people repeat it; trust what you have seen for yourself.
tone: Light comic con played straight: sunny road, a deadpan goat, thieves who over-act, and a decent man whose certainty wears away in three clear steps. The joke is always on the trick, never cruel to the ascetic.

beats.summary: An ascetic buys a fat goat at the market.
He ties a rope round its neck: the rope is the story's key object.
He suspects nothing; eyes open in the tree behind him.
Three thieves see the goat and want it for nothing.
They agree a strange trick: no force, make him abandon it himself.
Thief 1: why are you leading a dog? (1)
The ascetic laughs: this is a goat. Full confidence.
Thief 2: a man like you leading a dog? (2)
He stops. Why does everyone call it a dog?
Thief 3, confident: certainly a dog. Who sold it to you? (3 out of 3)
One man's eyes against three men's words.
He convinces himself the seller bewitched his eyes.
He unties the rope and abandons the goat himself.
The thieves come out and take the goat without a struggle.
He is still hunting the seller; the goat was a goat all along.

sets.description: The planned marketStreet set (AN-095, KD-011), palette clear, plus one animal stall: striped red and white awning on two posts at x 560..820, counter y 800, tether post at x 590, hay pile, two baskets. Option stall empty for the ending. Ground y 900.

A 3000-unit road strip (same strip builder as the planned chaseRoad): Library sky day, hillTrees, ground at y 900 with a paler dirt band y 900..960, grass tufts. Landmarks: big tree x 420 (trunk w 110, crown top y 300), milestone x 1260 (60 w x 80 h grey stone), bush x 1760, low wall x 2350 (220 w x 70 h, also a seat), bush x 2420, tree x 2520, tiny house on the horizon at x 2900. All positions are proposals; adjust on the stills.

props.description: Rope from the holder's fist to a loop round the goat's neck: a quadratic curve whose sag grows as the two ends come closer, 7 px black line with a 4 px tan core; states loop, knot 0..1, lying loose on the ground in an S.
coinPile / single coin (planned in AN-095): yellow disc r 10 with black rim.
Flat cartoon dog head and shoulders, about 90 px: brown, long drooping ear, black nose, red tongue. Used only inside balloons and thought clouds.
Simple two-pan scale for the thought cloud: post 160 high, beam 300 long pivoting by tilt (-0.5..0.5 rad), two pans hanging on V lines, each pan 110 wide.
Empty brown sack with a patch, about 90 x 110, droops when lowered.
Three small costume items drawn over the thief figure: turban (white wrap over the cap), false beard (grey bib on two ear strings, swings), long cloak with tall turban.

subtitles.ar: في يوم من الأيام، ذهب ناسك إلى السوق واشترى ماعزًا سمينًا.|دفع ثمنه، وربط حبلًا حول رقبته،|ثم بدأ يمشي به إلى بيته.|كان سعيدًا بما اشتراه، ولم يشك في شيء.
subtitles.en: One day, an ascetic went to the market and bought a fat goat.|He paid for it, tied a rope around its neck,|and started walking home with it.|He was pleased with his purchase and suspected nothing.

subtitles.ar: رأى ثلاثة لصوص الماعز، وأرادوا أخذه دون أن يدفعوا مالًا.|اجتمعوا خلف شجرة، واتفقوا على حيلة غريبة.|قال أحدهم: «لن نسرق الماعز بالقوة.|سنجعل الرجل يتركه بنفسه.»
subtitles.en: Three thieves saw the goat and wanted to take it without paying.|They met behind a tree and agreed on a strange trick.|One said, “We will not steal the goat by force.|We will make the man abandon it himself.”

subtitles.ar: وقف اللص الأول عند الطريق،|وحين مر الناسك سأله بدهشة: «لماذا تقود كلبًا إلى بيتك؟»|ضحك الناسك وقال: «هذا ماعز، وليس كلبًا!|ألا ترى جيدًا؟» ثم واصل طريقه.
subtitles.en: The first thief stood by the road.|When the ascetic passed, he asked in surprise, “Why are you leading a dog home?”|The ascetic laughed. “This is a goat, not a dog!|Can you not see properly?” Then he continued on his way.

subtitles.ar: بعد قليل، ظهر اللص الثاني، ونظر إلى الماعز مستغربًا.|قال: «رجل مثلك يقود كلبًا في الشارع؟ هذا أمر عجيب!»|توقف الناسك وقال لنفسه: «لماذا يسميه الجميع كلبًا؟»
subtitles.en: A little later, the second thief appeared and stared at the goat in astonishment.|“A man like you leading a dog through the street? How strange!” he said.|The ascetic stopped and wondered, “Why does everyone call it a dog?”

subtitles.ar: ثم جاء اللص الثالث، وقال بصوت واثق:|«يا رجل، هذا كلب بلا شك. من باعه لك؟»|نظر الناسك إلى الحيوان مرة أخرى،|وبدأ يشعر بالقلق والحيرة.
subtitles.en: Then the third thief came and said confidently,|“My good man, that is certainly a dog. Who sold it to you?”|The ascetic looked at the animal again|and began to feel worried and confused.

subtitles.ar: فكر الناسك: «أنا رأيت ماعزًا في السوق،|لكن ثلاثة رجال يقولون إنه كلب.|هل خدعني البائع؟ أم أنني لا أرى الحقيقة؟»|ولم يعرف أي كلام يصدق.
subtitles.en: The ascetic thought, “I saw a goat at the market,|but three men say it is a dog.|Did the seller deceive me? Or can I no longer see the truth?”|He did not know whom to believe.

subtitles.ar: أخيرًا، أقنع نفسه أن البائع ربما سحر عينيه.|فك الحبل عن رقبة الماعز، وتركه عند جانب الطريق،|ثم عاد إلى السوق غاضبًا ليبحث عن الرجل الذي باعه له.
subtitles.en: At last, he convinced himself that perhaps the seller had cast a spell on his eyes.|He untied the rope, left the goat beside the road,|and returned angrily to the market to look for the seller.

subtitles.ar: خرج اللصوص الثلاثة من أماكنهم، وأمسكوا الماعز ومضوا به.|كانوا يضحكون لأن خطتهم نجحت دون صراع.|أما الناسك فكان يبحث عن البائع،|ولا يعلم أن الماعز كان ماعزًا طوال الوقت.
subtitles.en: The three thieves emerged from their hiding places, took the goat, and went away.|They laughed because their plan had worked without a struggle.|The ascetic, meanwhile, was looking for the seller,|unaware that his goat had been a goat all along.

new_assets.name: goat
new_assets.description: Fat comic goat, reusable for any farm or village story. Pose fields: ph, amp (walk), fat 0..1, chew, talk (bleat), headDown 0..1 (graze), headTilt, earLift, ears, tailUp, asDog 0..1, plus the shared acting fields.
new_assets.implementation: Copy the deer structure (four legs driven by ph/amp, body, neck, head) and change proportions: body ellipse 150 x 85 with a second belly ellipse scaled by fat, legs 55 long, neck 40. Head: rounded wedge 60 x 46, two horns as tapered arcs, chin tuft triangle, ear ellipses rotated by ears, eye via eye2 with a horizontal bar pupil. chew = jaw offset on a 3 Hz sine sideways. asDog blends parameters only: horn length x (1 - asDog), tuft x (1 - asDog), ear length x (1 + asDog) rotated down, tail length x (1 + 1.5 asDog) with a wag sine, tongue alpha asDog. Wrap with acting() and add a registry entry and catalogue poses.

new_assets.name: person costume presets (ascetic, plus thief disguise items)
new_assets.description: Adds an ascetic preset to the planned person costume layer (small white turban, long white beard, plain robe, prayer beads) and three overlay items for the thief kind (turban, false beard, cloak with tall turban).
new_assets.implementation: Same costume layer as planned for AN-095: draw headwear and beard after the head, robe as a recoloured owner gown. Beads: 9 small circles on a hanging arc from the hand, swung with swing(). Disguise items are drawn after the thief head and take an on 0..1 value so they can pop on, slip and come off.

new_assets.name: countryRoad
new_assets.description: Long road strip with named hiding places (tree, milestone, bush, low wall) and a far house; reusable for any travel or roadside story.
new_assets.implementation: bake() a 3000 x 1230 canvas: sky(), hillTrees() tiled three times, ground(), a dirt band rectangle with dot shading, tree() twice with custom opts, bush() twice, milestone and wall as outlined rectangles with a top highlight, house as a 40 px box and roof triangle. Export an anchors object with the x positions. Occluders (trunk, bush front, wall) are also drawn in a second pass after the actors for the peeks.

new_assets.name: marketStreet
new_assets.description: Reuse of the planned marketStreet with an animal stall option (stall: full or empty).
new_assets.implementation: Add a stall(ctx, x, o) drawing: two posts, striped awning polygon with a 3-unit flap sine, counter box, hay ellipses, baskets, tether post. Called on top of the marketStreet bake.

new_assets.name: rope (lead)
new_assets.description: A lead rope between a hand and an animal neck that sags, goes taut, can be untied and lie on the ground.
new_assets.implementation: quadraticCurveTo between the two anchor points with control point lowered by sag = clamp(len0 - distance, 0, 60); loop = ellipse round the neck anchor; knot = small circle whose two tails shorten as knot goes to 0; ground state = a fixed S curve.

new_assets.name: dogIcon, balanceScale, sack, coin
new_assets.description: Small flat props (see props). The coin is the planned coinPile drawing.
new_assets.implementation: Each is under 20 lines of kit shapes: circles, ellipses, rounded boxes, K outlines. balanceScale takes tilt and draws pans at the beam ends so items placed in a pan use the returned pan positions.

new_assets.name: thoughtCloud
new_assets.description: The planned generic thought cloud large enough to stage action in (used here for the plan, the scale, the imagined seller).
new_assets.implementation: Generalise the Thief story cloud(): thoughtCloud(ctx, box, p, drawInside) clips to the cloud shape, calls drawInside, then draws the outline and three trailing puffs toward the thinker.

new_assets.name: dream wash
new_assets.description: The planned blue halftone overlay with dotted vignette, used here to mark the ascetic's unreliable view (116.42-117.7).
new_assets.implementation: Panel-clipped blue fill at alpha 0.25 with multiply, plus a radial ring of Ben-Day dots at the border; alpha keyed in and out over 0.2 s.

new_assets.name: spiralEyes
new_assets.description: Two slow spirals in place of the pupils for half a second (bewitched, dizzy, hypnotised).
new_assets.implementation: Overlay at the person eye positions: white disc r 11, then a 2-turn Archimedean spiral stroke rotating at 1 turn per second. Also uses the planned flush expression for anger in S16 and S19.

new_assets.name: inset circle
new_assets.description: A round picture-in-picture panel that opens with an iris to show a second place at the same time.
new_assets.implementation: Save, clip to a circle of keyed radius, draw the second world with its own camera, restore, then stroke a fat black tapering border and a paper ring.

owner_questions: The thieves put comic disguises (turban, false beard, cloak) over their striped outfits and masks when they meet the ascetic; the script does not mention disguises. Default: keep them, because they are funny and explain why he does not suspect.

In two short moments (83.1 and 116.4-117.7) the goat is drawn turning into a dog, only as the ascetic's doubtful view inside a blue dream wash. Default: keep; the real goat is never anything but a goat.
The seller is shown as honest; he appears as a cheat or a sorcerer only inside the ascetic's thought clouds, and the stall is empty at the end. Default: keep this reading.

Invented English lettering beyond the script: FAT GOAT, HOME, 3 THIEVES, THE BOSS, NO FORCE, THIEF 1/2/3, DOG? counter, 3 OUT OF 3, 1 vs 3, ZAP!, LEFT BEHIND, TOO EASY!, STILL A GOAT, MEH!, MAAA!, HA HA!. Default: keep all; the animator may drop the weakest if the frame is busy.
The ascetic is drawn as a generic holy man (white turban, long beard, plain robe, prayer beads) with no specific religious symbols. Default: this look.
No moral card is added because the narration does not state a moral; the film ends on the goat and THE END. Default: no moral card.
implementation_notes: Start from Library/template. Word cues come from timing.json via w(p, n); every cue time in this plan is a word start from planning/inputs/timeline.md. Word starts can sit up to 0.4 s early; check the three DOG balloons (50.88, 73.60, 91.46) against the audio.

countryRoad is one baked 3000-unit world; the camera clamps to it. Ascetic position is one function AX(t) for the whole road so walk() and footfalls() never slide; stops: x 1090 (46.5-60.9), x 1560 (77.1-84.0), x 2110 (87.4-101.7), wall seat x 2140 (101.7-131.3). The goat follows at AX - 150 with a 0.25 s lag; rope sag from their distance.
The thieves must visibly get ahead of him: they exit right at 41.1-41.4 while he waits with the grazing goat far left; thief2 and thief3 are already in the bush and behind the wall when he arrives.
Peeks: draw the actor, then the occluder (trunk, bush front, wall) again on top; no clipped second copies.
Counter DOG? uses S.counter top-right of the picture panel at 50.88 (1), 73.60 (2), 91.46 (3); hide it at 95.0. The three thieves each get one S.label + S.arrow on their ordinal word.

Three different liars: thief1 over-acts surprise (cheeks, double take), thief2 inspects and pities (nose to nose, tuts), thief3 is calm authority (hips, folded arms, hand on the shoulder). The ascetic answers with laugh, stop and think, then worry. Keep these distinct; do not reuse one reaction.

The goat is the constant: same chew, same slow blink in every scene. Give it LIFE auto-blinks and a gaze target in every shot. asDog is used only at 83.12-83.5 (max 0.3) and 116.42-117.7 (max 0.9) under the dream wash.
Setup and payoff: the leader's rope-drop mime at 39.46 must be the same hand pose as the ascetic's real drop at 131.3; the temple tap at 38.10 returns at 150.8.
Person arms are short: use arm angles (aL/aR) for big readable poses (raised finger, fists on hips, rope held high) and hand targets only for contact (shoulder, knot, ear).

Sound: only four effects, in the listed pauses and after the last word: pop 20.5, whoosh 41.4, whoosh 62.6 (under the LATER card), chime 162.9. SND master 0.6. Lettering such as CLINK! and ZAP! is silent.
Lettering never covers a face and stays inside the picture panel (y under 1250). Keep balloons on the far side of the speaker from the listener.
Film length 166.0 s (audio 162.54 + 3.5 hold). Panel-only shake is not needed anywhere; do not add any.
warnings: New drawing load is above the usual four: goat (M), ascetic costume and disguise items (M), countryRoad (M), market stall (S) plus small props. marketStreet, thoughtCloud, dream wash, flush, person sit and the costume layer are planned by other stories but not yet in Library; if this film is built first it must create them.
The word اللص in paragraph 4 (65.62) has an interpolated time; the THIEF 2 label is cued to الثاني at 65.62 instead.
به at 148.10 is interpolated and shares its time with كانوا; scene S18 starts on that boundary, so check the cut against the audio.

Three similar encounters in a row are the main risk of monotony: vary the place (milestone, bush, wall), the entrance (skid in, rise from bush, stride in), the camera and the ascetic's reaction as specified.
The asDog morph must read as his imagination, not as magic: keep it under the dream wash and never show it in an objective shot.
